title: Taslima Nasreen's Return to Kolkata Raises Concerns Over Housing and Safety
summary: Taslima Nasreen, a Bangladeshi author, returned to her hometown of Kolkata after 19 years due to security concerns. She faced difficulties finding accommodation in the city, citing a lack of affordable housing options. The government has been criticized for its handling of the situation, with some outlets alleging that it is not doing enough to address the issue. Nasreen's return highlights the need for improved housing policies and increased safety measures in the city.
summary_points: Taslima Nasreen returned to Kolkata after 19 years due to security concerns
